content: Godatoo! Inttes salon Goday dizayssa intte eriza gishshas inttes ooththizaytas tumaninne suureteththan ooththite.
Gujo Zore
Beeggidi galatara gaththi pacey baynda Xoossaa woossite.
Ta iza gishshas qashettida Kirstoosa xuuraa awajjanaas dandayana mala Xoossi nuus qaala yootanaas oge doyana mala nu gishshassika woossite.
Qasseka haasayanaas bessiza qaala qonccen ta haasayana mala taas woossite.
Ammanontta asatara inttes diza hanoteththan aadho erateththan simerettite; inttes beettida lo7o qaadan go7ettite.
Issoy issaas intte zaaro wostti immanaakko intte erana mala intte haasayay maxinera kaxxida kaththa mala mal7o gido.
Wurseththa Saroka
Tiqiqoosi ta duussaa gishshas wursi inttes yootana; izi daro dosettida ishanne Godaas tanara issife ooththiza ammanettida oosanchcha.
Nu duussaa gishshas intte erana malanne intte wozina minththana mala tani iza intteko kiittadis.
Izi intte bagga gididi ammanettidaadenne dosettidaade gidida nu ishaa Anasmoosara intteko yaana; isttika haan diza hanoza ubbaa inttes yootana.

Barnabaasa aawaa michchey naa Marqoosinne tanara issife qashettida Arxirokoosi inttena saro geettes. Marqoosa gishshas intte ay ooththanaakko kase inttena ta qofsa woththida mala izi intteko gakkishin iza mokki ekkite.
Iyosxoosa geetettiza Iyaasoykka inttena saro gees; Ayhuda asaa giddofe Xoossa Kawoteththas tanara ooththizayti haytantta xalla; istti tana minththeththida.

Intte baggafe gidida Yesus Kirstoosa oosanchcha Ephafiray inttena saro gees; izikka inttena Ayana duussan lo7eththi minnidi mulera woppu giidi Xoossa shenen minni eqqana mala ubba wode intte gishshas woosan baaxetees.
Qasseka intte gishshas hessaththoka Lodoqiyaninne Iyarpolise kataman dizaytas izi pacey baynda ooththizayssa ta iza gishshas markkattays.
Daro dosettida aakime Luqaasinne Deemaasi inttena saro geettes.
Lodoqiyan diza nu ishatas, Nimpusinne izi keeththan shiiqiza ammaniza asatas ta sarokaa yootite.
Hanna ta kiitaya inttes nababettida mala qasseka Lodoqiyan diza Woosa Keeththayn nababettana mala ooththite; intteka qasse Lodoqiyappe inttes kiitettida kiitaa nababite.
Arikiphaases, «Neni Godaappe ekkida oosoza wurseth gaththanaas minna» giite.
Hayssa sarokaa tani Phawuloosi ta kushera xaafadis; ta qashetta dizayssa dogopite; Xoossa kiyateththi inttenara gido.
